items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Frankie Doosen up at St. Mastonic Hall. I didn't know if you heard him up there. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I've heard him.

ctx.x: I'd known he worked uptown, I think, with the Eagle Band, Frankie Doosen up at St. Mastonic Hall. I didn't know if you heard him up there.
